# Vild markedsturbulens fortsætter - hvor ender AI-aktiernes rutschetur?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Danish Millionærklubben episode (Euroinvestor, Saxo Bank-sponsored) covers severe AI-driven market volatility. The Nasdaq fell about 20% from its peak at the intraday low, and Nvidia went through turmoil when Jensen Huang was ousted and then reinstated after spy allegations. Guest Lars Tvede calls the sell-off one of the three most irrational markets he has seen and argues fundamentals are sound and record panic indicators point to a bottom. He is bullish long-term on commodities, mining and chips (preferring a chip ETF over the newly listed Anthropic). Christian Kongsted reads yesterday's intraday reversal as a possible bottom, has bought AMD instead of Nvidia, and is waiting on Anthropic because of lock-up selling pressure.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AMD — AMD | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Kongsted (guest) has bought AMD instead of Nvidia: rising earnings estimates while the share price falls, plus a tailwind from Nvidia's governance turmoil.

#### Reasoning

Guest Christian Kongsted says analysts keep raising AMD's earnings estimates while the stock falls, creating a large gap between price and earnings expectations. AMD also benefits as a competitor while Nvidia deals with the Huang saga and a political aftermath in Congress. He sees it as the better place to be in AI chips right now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if analysts start cutting AMD earnings estimates
- if Nvidia's political/governance overhang clears and the competitive tailwind fades
- if AI chip demand weakens

> *"Jeg har købt op i AMD som deres konkurrent, som jeg tror, hvor man kan se, der er sådan en generelt tendens til, at analytikerne bliver ved med at opjustere tallene til indtjeningen, samtidig med, at aktien falder i pris."*

---

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Kongsted (guest) will not buy Nvidia now: too much uncertainty from the Congress follow-up to the Huang saga, and he already has exposure through other AI stocks.

#### Reasoning

Kongsted does not consider the Jensen Huang case closed, since a political aftermath in Congress is still ahead. He sees the uncertainty as too large and already has AI exposure, so he chooses to stay out short-term. Lars Tvede is more sanguine: he calls the allegations a 'nothing-burger' and the board's handling the real failure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Congress inquiry concludes without consequences
- if news flow around Huang calms down

> *"Altså, jeg kommer ikke til at samle den op her, fordi jeg synes, der er for store usikkerheder omkring den, og fordi jeg er eksponeret til det tema via forskellige andre aktier"*

---
